fields.title: Vespa search engine
chunks: Vespa is a distributed search engine.
Search nodes evaluate queries close to the stored data.
Distributed content nodes divide documents into buckets.
Ranking profiles calculate relevance for every search result.
Online feeding keeps the distributed index fresh.
Tensor functions combine lexical and semantic search signals.

fields.title: Distributed search platform
chunks: A search engine builds an index from many documents.
Distributed systems replicate data across several machines.
A coordinator sends each search request to many workers.
Each worker scans its local distributed partition.
The engine merges search results from every node.
Monitoring detects failures in a distributed cluster.
